raw_loading: Bounded official scalar NPY dictionary; restricted NumPy-only Unpickler; no arbitrary globals or executable source import.
original_full_image_duplicates: Unknown: no source image IDs, full frames, crop-to-frame mapping, or scene IDs in this release directory.
tracer110_or_training_scene_overlap: Unknown: this audit does not establish scene independence from tracer110 or official training data.

conditioning.location: Already localized 20x20 crop; official classifier additionally marks crop center.
conditioning.path: Provided 4-6 ordered spline points specify the queried strand.
conditioning.direction: Official transform uses the supplied points to align orientation, modulo 180 degrees.
conditioning.start: No global cable-start field in this cropped subset. Full HANDLOOM pipeline separately requires starting pixels.
conditioning.provenance: The subset does not identify whether each conditioning spline was manually annotated or derived from a tracer.

supported_evaluation: Conditional local under/over classification with provided target-strand coordinates, under a separate protocol.
unsupported_evaluation: Visible occlusion-side identity association with positive and negative pair ground truth
visibility_and_identity: No per-point visibility, complete cable IDs, competing-strand identity, masks, endpoints, or explicit positive/negative identity events. Sparse splines must not be dilated into segmentation GT.
decision: Audit-only supplementary public crossing resource; excluded from the frozen model-evaluation queue and primary identity metrics.

evidence.finding: Official evaluator selects this exact cropped test set and supplies its dataset fields.
Reads provided spline conditioning; writes spline into channel 0, crossing center into channel 1, rotates the input; target is under_over.
Conditioned rotation uses direction between first and last supplied path points, modulo 180 degrees.
Official classifier config: 20x20, crop_width10, rot_cond=True, mark_crossing=True.
Official visualizer maps 0 to undercrossing, 1 to overcrossing.
Full pipeline first traces from starting pixels, derives crossings, crops and supplies the traced spline to the classifier.
Official documentation describes crossing classification on crops of real images.
